verses.greek: Κἀγὼ ἐλθὼν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, ἦλθον οὐ καθʼ ὑπεροχὴν λόγου ἢ σοφίας καταγγέλλων ὑμῖν τὸ μαρτύριον τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.literal: And I myself having come to you brothers came not according to excellency of speech or wisdom proclaiming to you the μαρτύριον the of God.
verses.dgt: And when I came to you, brothers and sisters, I did not come with superiority of speech or wisdom, proclaiming to you the mystery of God.

verses.greek: οὐ γὰρ ἔκρινά τι εἰδέναι ἐν ὑμῖν εἰ μὴ Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν καὶ τοῦτον ἐσταυρωμένον·
verses.literal: Nothing for I decided anything to know among you only except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.
verses.dgt: For I decided to know nothing among you except Jesus Christ, and him crucified.

verses.greek: κἀγὼ ἐν ἀσθενείᾳ καὶ ἐν φόβῳ καὶ ἐν τρόμῳ πολλῷ ἐγενόμην πρὸς ὑμᾶς,
verses.literal: And I myself in weakness and in fear and in trembling much was with you
verses.dgt: And I was with you in weakness and in fear and in much trembling,

verses.greek: καὶ ὁ λόγος μου καὶ τὸ κήρυγμά μου οὐκ ἐν πειθοῖ σοφίας ἀλλʼ ἐν ἀποδείξει πνεύματος καὶ δυνάμεως,
verses.literal: And the message of mine and the preaching of mine were not in persuasive of wisdom but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power
verses.dgt: and my speech and my proclamation were not in persuasive words of wisdom, but in demonstration of Spirit and power,

verses.greek: ἵνα ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν μὴ ᾖ ἐν σοφίᾳ ἀνθρώπων ἀλλʼ ἐν δυνάμει θεοῦ.
verses.literal: so that the faith of you not may be in wisdom of men but in power of God.
verses.dgt: so that your faith might not be in human wisdom but in the power of God.

verses.greek: Σοφίαν δὲ λαλοῦμεν ἐν τοῖς τελείοις, σοφίαν δὲ οὐ τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου οὐδὲ τῶν ἀρχόντων τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου τῶν καταργουμένων·
verses.literal: Wisdom however we speak among the mature wisdom however not the age of this nor of the rulers the age of this who are coming to naught
verses.dgt: Yet we speak wisdom among the mature, but not wisdom of this age nor of the rulers of this age, who are being brought to nothing.

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ λαλοῦμεν θεοῦ σοφίαν ἐν μυστηρίῳ, τὴν ἀποκεκρυμμένην, ἣν προώρισεν ὁ θεὸς πρὸ τῶν αἰώνων εἰς δόξαν ἡμῶν·
verses.literal: But we speak of God wisdom in a mystery which hidden which foreordained the God before the ages for glory of us
verses.dgt: Rather, we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the hidden wisdom that God predestined before the ages for our glory,

verses.greek: ἣν οὐδεὶς τῶν ἀρχόντων τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου ἔγνωκεν, εἰ γὰρ ἔγνωσαν, οὐκ ἂν τὸν κύριον τῆς δόξης ἐσταύρωσαν·
verses.literal: which none of the rulers the age of this has understood if for they had understood it not then would the Lord the of glory they crucified
verses.dgt: which none of the rulers of this age understood; for if they had understood it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται· Ἃ ὀφθαλμὸς οὐκ εἶδεν καὶ οὖς οὐκ ἤκουσεν καὶ ἐπὶ καρδίαν ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἀνέβη, ὅσα ἡτοίμασεν ὁ θεὸς τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν αὐτόν.
verses.literal: but even as it has been written: What eye not has seen and ear not has heard and into heart of man not has entered ὅσα has prepared the God for those loving Him.
verses.dgt: But just as it is written, “What eye has not seen and ear has not heard, and what has not entered into the human heart—what God prepared for those who love him.”

verses.greek: ἡμῖν γὰρ ἀπεκάλυψεν ὁ θεὸς διὰ τοῦ πνεύματος, τὸ γὰρ πνεῦμα πάντα ἐραυνᾷ, καὶ τὰ βάθη τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.literal: To us γὰρ revealed it the God through the Spirit The for Spirit all things searches even the depths the of God.
verses.dgt: For God revealed these things to us through the Spirit; for the Spirit searches all things, even the depths of God.

verses.greek: τίς γὰρ οἶδεν ἀνθρώπων τὰ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου εἰ μὴ τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τὸ ἐν αὐτῷ; οὕτως καὶ τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐδεὶς ἔγνωκεν εἰ μὴ τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.literal: Who for knows among men the things of the man only except the spirit of the man that is within him? So also the things the of God no one has known only except the Spirit the of God.
verses.dgt: For who among people knows the things of a person except the spirit of the person that is in them? So also no one has known the things of God except the Spirit of God.

verses.greek: ἡμεῖς δὲ οὐ τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ κόσμου ἐλάβομεν ἀλλὰ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα εἰδῶμεν τὰ ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ χαρισθέντα ἡμῖν·
verses.literal: We ourselves now not the spirit of the world have received but the Spirit who is from the God that we may know the things by the God having been granted to us
verses.dgt: Now we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, so that we may know the things freely given to us by God,

verses.greek: ἃ καὶ λαλοῦμεν οὐκ ἐν διδακτοῖς ἀνθρωπίνης σοφίας λόγοις, ἀλλʼ ἐν διδακτοῖς πνεύματος, πνευματικοῖς πνευματικὰ συγκρίνοντες.
verses.literal: which also we speak not in taught of human wisdom words but in those taught of the Spirit by spiritual means spiritual things communicating.
verses.dgt: which things we also speak, not in words taught by human wisdom, but in those taught by the Spirit, interpreting spiritual things with spiritual words.

verses.greek: Ψυχικὸς δὲ ἄνθρωπος οὐ δέχεται τὰ τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ θεοῦ, μωρία γὰρ αὐτῷ ἐστίν, καὶ οὐ δύναται γνῶναι, ὅτι πνευματικῶς ἀνακρίνεται·
verses.literal: The natural however man not accepts the things of the Spirit the of God foolishness for to him they are and not he is able to understand them because spiritually they are discerned.
verses.dgt: But a natural person does not receive the things of the Spirit of God, for they are foolishness to that person, and they cannot know them because they are spiritually discerned.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ πνευματικὸς ἀνακρίνει τὰ πάντα, αὐτὸς δὲ ὑπʼ οὐδενὸς ἀνακρίνεται.
verses.literal: He who is however spiritual judges the all things he himself however by no one is judged.
verses.dgt: But the spiritual person discerns all things, while being discerned by no one.

verses.greek: τίς γὰρ ἔγνω νοῦν κυρίου, ὃς συμβιβάσει αὐτόν; ἡμεῖς δὲ νοῦν Χριστοῦ ἔχομεν.
verses.literal: Who for has known the mind of the Lord? Who will instruct Him? We ourselves however the mind of Christ have.
verses.dgt: For “who has known the mind of the Lord, who will instruct him?” But we have the mind of Christ.
